messages:
Lia (Design): Quick thought — users want a one-click 'snapback' for recent rollouts but we keep hitting accidental triggers. Proposal: a tiny inline confirmation pill that requires a short intent drag (slide-to-confirm) for destructive rollbacks. Low-friction but prevents clicks.

Owen (PM): Interesting. Support logs show most mistakes are single clicks. Slide-to-confirm reduces accidental triggers. Ops: need audit + optional reason for anything that changes >15%.

Sloane (Frontend): Slide affordance could be keyboard accessible: hold-space or long-press equivalent. How do we do accessible slide?

Ben (A11y): Don't rely on pure drag. Provide equivalent keyboard and SR flows: a visible slider for pointer users, and a single-button 'Confirm rollback' that only appears after pressing Enter on the pill for 1.2s (long-press emulate). Announce progress via `aria-live="polite"`.

Lia (Design): Copy idea for the pill: small text "Snapback to v8" + hint "slide to confirm". After complete show toast: "Rolled back to v8. Undo within 2m." Keep SR copy concise.

Owen (PM): If slide target >15% or target=100%, degrade to modal with required short reason and checkbox 'I understand rollback impact'. Also flag for ops.

Sloane (Frontend): Implementation sketch:
- visual slider with track and handle, 220px width on desktop, touch draggable
- fallback button appears on keyboard activation with aria-pressed while holding.
CSS example:
```
.slider { width:220px; background:#f3f4f6; border-radius:999px; }
.handle { width:44px; height:28px; border-radius:999px; background:#fff; box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.08); }
```

Ben (A11y): ARIA notes: slider should not use role="slider" since it's not a value control. Use a custom pattern: role="button" with `aria-label="Slide to confirm rollback to version 8"` and `aria-live` updates on progress: "Slide 30 percent" -> "Slide complete". For keyboard, space/enter to begin and again to complete. Provide `prefers-reduced-motion` fallback (no sliding animation).

Lia (Design): Microcopy for the modal (big rollback): "Rollback to v8 — routes X% to v8. This is a large change; please confirm and add a short reason." Buttons: [Confirm rollback] [Cancel]. Required checkbox for >25% changes: "I understand this will affect user traffic".

Owen (PM): Add a small 'why slide?' tooltip explaining accidental clicks and the safety benefit, to reduce confusion. And log every interaction with user id + method (slider/button/modal).

Sloane (Frontend): We'll show a tiny metric row inside the pill on hover (latency / errors) to help decisioning. Tooltip must be focusable.

Ben (A11y): Tooltip must be reachable via keyboard and have `aria-describedby`. For SRs announce metric snapshot when user focuses the pill: "Latency 180ms, errors 0.3 percent". Keep <=120 chars.

deploy-bot: Audit: rollback v8 by lia (uid: u_998) recorded. method: slide. job 44577.

Lia (Design): Nice. I'll add mocks for desktop/mobile and annotate a11y behaviors in Figma. We'll test with keyboard-only flow in next QA.

Sloane (Frontend): I'll prototype accessible slide + keyboard fallback and include analytics hooks. PR incoming.

Ben (A11y): I'll draft the SR announcement strings and check the timing for long-press threshold. Suggest 1.2s debounce to avoid accidental triggers.

Owen (PM): I'll update product rules: slide allowed for <=15% and within 10 minutes of last rollout; otherwise modal. Ops will require reason for >15% or older changes. Thanks team :rocket:
